# Third-party code

Third-party sources are vendored here so host and target builds do not depend
on system packages beyond SDL2 and GLES2.

| Directory | Upstream | Revision | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stb/` | https://github.com/nothings/stb (`stb_image_write.h`) | `48fb1c9709f973041a7e6992d720ac625266cdd3` | MIT / public domain (dual) |
| `jsmn/` | https://github.com/zserge/jsmn (`jsmn.h`) | `25647e692c7906b96ffd2b05ca54c097948e879c` | MIT |

The license text for each project is kept at the top of its header, and the
full stb license is reproduced at the bottom of `stb/stb_image_write.h`.
